A better desktop widget. If you installed Daybook with the installer, the app offers this update by itself. Restart Daybook, or press **Settings → Updates → Check for updates**, to see it straight away.

## Fixed

- **A pinned widget ignored clicks.** While the panel was open, the pin on a pinned widget did nothing, so it could not be unpinned. After a restart nothing on a pinned widget could be pressed at all, ticking habits included. Every click now gets through, and clicking a pinned widget still does not pull it in front of your windows.
- **The thin white line round the widget is gone.** Windows 11 draws a light border round every window. The widget no longer has one, so a dark widget has a clean dark edge.
- **The Ring dial never filled.** Its ring stayed grey whatever you had done. It now fills with the day's habits.
- **The date was shown twice.** When the clock shows the date, the line at the top no longer repeats it.
- Opening the panel while it is minimised brings it back up.

## Changed

- **The widget is as big as what is in it.** One habit makes a small widget, five a taller one. Past a point the list scrolls instead of the widget growing down the screen. Its edge is no longer dragged: choose **Small**, **Medium** or **Large** in **Settings → Desktop widget**.
- **Today is one line**, "Today · 3 of 4 done · 12-day streak", above your habits. The large number and ring are gone.
- **The light behind the clock** is one soft, even circle, centred on the clock and fading out with no edge.
- **One accent colour runs through the widget:** the second hand, the light, the lines that fill as habits are done and the ticked tasks. A finished habit shows a tick and lights up once.
- **The weather can be turned off:** **Settings → Desktop widget → Show the weather**.
- The Mono dial now makes the whole widget black, white and grey.

## Downloading

- **Windows:** `Daybook-Setup-1.4.2.exe` (installs, and updates itself) or `Daybook-1.4.2-portable.exe` (runs without installing). Windows will say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Press **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** `Daybook-1.4.2-mac.dmg`. The first time, macOS refuses to open it. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and press **Open Anyway** next to Daybook.

Both warnings are about the missing paid signing certificates, not about the program. The source is all in this repository if you would rather build it yourself.
